title: Wrist rehab
notes: About 20 minutes, every session. Light dumbbell or hammer only. Pain-free range. Stop any drill that pinches, clicks sharply, or swells.

exercises.name: Wrist flexion / extension
exercises.notes: Forearm on a bench, hand hanging. Slow nods. No heavy squeeze at the end.

exercises.name: Hammer pronation / supination
exercises.load: Light hammer or DB held at one end
exercises.notes: Elbow tucked to the ribs. Rotate palm up and down like a slow doorknob.

exercises.name: Radial / ulnar deviation
exercises.notes: Thumb-up and pinky-down waves. A tiny range is enough.

exercises.name: Soft grip squeezes
exercises.notes: Squeeze to about half effort, then fully open the hand.

exercises.name: Gentle circles and stretches
exercises.notes: Slow circles, then easy prayer and reverse-prayer stretches. Do not force end range.
